card.name: Spaces before metformin dose amounts
card.fires_on: The blank space or opening bracket right after 'metformin' (or 'and' after pioglitazone) just before a dose number such as 850 mg or 500 mg. A few strays appear in general text, like 'day' after 'one'.

modes.label: Gap before metformin dose
modes.description: The space or bracket after metformin or 'pioglitazone and' where a milligram number comes next.
modes.example: is 15 mg of pioglitazone and<< >>850 mg of metformin

modes.label: Bracket after drug name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after metformin leading into a dose.

modes.label: Stray general-text hits
modes.description: Occasional words in news prose where a comparison or match is expected next.
modes.example: so will women one<< day>> catch the men?

card.writes: It promotes 'matching' and 'match' words, which does not clearly fit a dose number; the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires at the small gap just before a metformin dose number in combination-tablet text.
